Privacy and cookies

Understand what is saved and where.

KickMaths uses nickname profiles and browser-saved learning records. Use this page to understand progress storage, reading preferences and what happens when you contact us.

Game profiles, learning evidence and backups.

Nicknames, answers, learning records, game rewards and player customisation are saved in the browser used to play. Clearing that browser’s site data can remove them. Backup and Restore in the grown-up area let you download and transfer a copy. Keep backups private, especially on shared school devices.

The game does not automatically synchronise local pupil reports across devices. The Squad League compares profiles saved in the same browser. An online league needs a separately available server; the GitHub Pages launch uses the local league.

Cookies and browser storage on this website.

The cookie banner lets you choose optional reading preferences and Google Analytics usage statistics separately. Both are off by default. Essential only keeps the site usable without enabling either option. For children, a parent, carer or teacher aged 18 or over should make the statistics choice. You can change or withdraw it using Cookie settings here or in the footer.

The game saves progress and functional settings when you use it. It does not show the website cookie banner. The grown-up area includes Optional usage statistics, where a parent, carer or teacher can also enable or switch off analytics for this browser. Your choice applies across the website and game on the same origin. It does not change access to the free beta or game rewards.

Optional Google Analytics usage statistics.

If an adult enables statistics, Google Analytics uses browser cookie identifiers and technical information about pages, devices and visits to help us understand use of KickMaths. We count game opens, match starts, resumes, saved or completed matches and whether a browser has answered a question. Our game events do not include player names, profile IDs, answers, scores, year groups or school details. Page addresses sent by our integration omit query strings and fragments, and we do not send referrer addresses.

Analytics is off until the adult-confirmed choice is saved. Google advertising personalisation and Google signals are disabled in the integration. The statistics reports are kept in the team’s Google Analytics account, accessible to people given permission there. They are not a public leaderboard. Because some visitors decline analytics or block it, figures cover measured use rather than every player. A browser shared by several pupils may count as one Analytics user.

The analytics cookies set by this integration have a 30-day expiry. Withdrawing permission stops future game statistics events from this integration and removes its analytics cookies where the browser permits it. Previously collected information is not automatically deleted by changing a browser setting; contact us for a data question. See how Google uses information from sites using its services.

Email and feedback.

Email enquiries go to enquiries@kickmaths.co.uk. Our feedback button opens an external Google Form; information entered there is sent to Google and the form owner. Please avoid sending children’s full names, contact details or other unnecessary personal information. Contact us if you need to discuss information you have supplied.

Hosting and your browser.

The website host receives normal technical information needed to deliver pages, such as an IP address and request details. Fonts and game assets are served with the site. Optional reading preferences can be changed using Cookie settings in the footer.

Privacy questions.

For a question about saved data or information sent to us, email enquiries@kickmaths.co.uk.
